verdict.rationale: Algolia documents a Search API that can 'search, configure, and manage your indices and records', plus a CLI built on its APIs, nine official API clients, and agent skills for managing settings, rules and synonyms. That shows broad programmatic coverage of core functions. However, nothing claims API parity with the dashboard, and several capabilities are described only as UI actions: connector schedules configured in the dashboard, Merchandising Studio's visual tools, and analytics export via a Download click. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, documented API coverage of dashboard-only features (connectors/scheduling, Merchandising Studio, analytics export), a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
